incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual auth traffic pattern detected for auth-proxy-prod. 600 req/min from 3 IPs in 5m window. Potential token replay. See alert: https://redir/alerts/1760019999
oncall-rotation: I'm on it — paging sec + infra. will triage and contain.
sre-jamie: Confirmed in proxy logs: repeated sequence of 401 then 200 with same session id. sample: `session=abc123 user=svc-ingest ip=203.0.113.45`
sec-ana: Likely token reuse. Immediate actions: 1) block IPs 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46, 198.51.100.12 at edge WAF 2) rotate service token for svc-ingest 3) check CI/S3 for leaked debug logs. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/auth-incident
cust-success-lee: Any confirmed customer impact? I have an open ticket from Acme Corp reporting intermittent 401s around the same window.
eng-runtime-raj: We can flip to read-only cached responses for customer queries during rotation to reduce customer errors. Also suggest throttling suspicious request paths to preserve capacity.
eng-infra-maya: Kicking off edge block now: `curl -s -X POST https://waf.internal/block -d 'ips=203.0.113.45,203.0.113.46,198.51.100.12'` -> 202 accepted. Starting svc-ingest key rotate: `./scripts/rotate_service_key svc-ingest --rotate-kms`
sre-jamie: Patching proxy to emit correlate-id for 401->200 flows and pushing a canary in us-west-2. Will tail for replays.
sec-ana: Please run: `k logs -n prod auth-proxy --since=15m | grep 'session=' | sed -n '1,200p'` and upload to secure bucket `s3://redwood-secure/incidents/1760019999` (access: sec + sre).
oncall-rotation: Confirmed: IP blocks active at edge. svc-ingest key rotated and old key disabled at 1760020500. Notifying customers and CS.
cust-success-lee: Updated ticket #4522: "We're investigating elevated auth failures; no confirmed data exposure at this time." I'll update customers if we confirm a log leak.
sec-ana: Found a debug log artifact in staging pipeline that contains a token fragment referencing svc-ingest. Investigating whether the fragment corresponds to the rotated token.
eng-infra-maya: Staging leak confirmed: pipeline job 4287 wrote debug to `/var/log/ci/debug.log` containing token fragment. Quarantined artifact, revoked job credentials, and started CI role rotation.
sre-jamie: Mitigation checklist: edge blocks applied, svc-ingest rotated, CI role rotated, proxy canary pushed, customer comms drafted. Recommend 2hr post-mortem + devex task to strip debug logs from pipelines.
sec-ana: Opening PagerDuty incident PD-INC-9873. Legal & privacy looped in. Will produce initial incident report in ~2h.
oncall-rotation: Handoff to SRE shift B at 1760021540. Leaving notes in the incident channel. Thanks all :thumbsup:
